text: Ridley is the bike brand of Belgian Cycling Factory of Beringen, Belgium, which describes itself as a 100% family-run company; the brand was founded by Jochim Aerts, who is the company's CEO.
short: Ridley belongs to Belgian Cycling Factory, a 100% family-run Belgian company.

source.name: Ridley: About Ridley
source.quote: Working at Belgian Cycling Factory, the parent company of Ridley, means working with passionate colleagues every day.
source.note: Same page: 'To this day, Ridley remains a 100% family-run company' and 'Our founder and CEO Jochim Aerts'.
